title: Finite stratified oriented products form a coherent conservative cover
statement: Let $S$ be Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], let $f:X\to S$ be of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $X=\coprod_\alpha X_\alpha$ and $S=\coprod_\beta S_\beta$ be finite constructible stratifications [def-constructible-stratification, def-weil-constructible-subset]. Put $P_{\alpha\beta}=(X_\alpha)_{\mathrm{Et}}\overleftarrow{\times}_{S_{\mathrm{Et}}}(S_\beta)_{\mathrm{Et}}$ [def-trf-oriented-nearby-cycles] and let $u:\coprod_{\alpha,\beta}P_{\alpha\beta}\to V_f$ be the geometric morphism [def-trf-geometric-morphism] induced by the stratum immersions and the oriented-product universal property [lem-trf-oriented-product-universal]. Then $u$ is coherent and conservative [def-trf-coherent-topos].

source.place: Author draft §8.1, printed p. 17, converse coherence argument via the finite coproduct of stratum oriented products; local archival copy WANTED.
